idle:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D game character idle animation sprite sheet for the Korean dark-fantasy game 괴이탐사국.
Primary request: Create ONE PNG sprite sheet depicting exactly FOUR full-body frames of the same new Attacker (돌격병) character in a subtle idle loop.
Input images: Image 1 (Offender idle sheet) and Image 2 (Defender action sheet) are STYLE, PIXEL DENSITY, CAMERA, PALETTE and SHEET-LAYOUT references only. Invent the Attacker identity below; do not reuse their spear, masks, shield or character designs.
Canvas and composition: EXACTLY 1536 pixels wide by 512 pixels tall, transparent RGBA, one horizontal row of four equal 384x512 cells. No cell borders. Centers at x=192,576,960,1344. Right-facing three-quarter side combat view in every frame, same camera and scale. Feet baseline y=500; figure height about 335 pixels including the pack frame. Keep every body and tool pixel within its own cell with at least 16 pixels of horizontal padding. All four entire figures fully visible.
Character: a sturdy, androgynous adult early agrarian porter and rescue worker, broad practical working build, human anatomy, low forward-leaning posture. Faded charcoal-brown heavy woven work tunic, patched dull umber leather apron and load-bearing harness, dark trousers, worn wrapped leather work boots. Faded dirty khaki cargo-wrapping cloth drapes over the head as a short loose hood, its horizontally folded band completely concealing forehead and eyes; nose, mouth and lower face remain exposed. This is ordinary removable cloth, not a full-face mask or mummy wrapping.
Equipment: modest wooden carrying frame strapped to the back, a short wooden carrying yoke secured to it, one thick rope coil, a compact supply satchel with water flask and a neatly rolled bandage, small wooden work mallet tucked at the belt. Hold ONE practical wooden-handled cart hook low across the front in both hands, modest curved dark-iron hook on its right end, normal human-sized tool about 160 pixels long, NOT a scythe, spear, axe or warhammer. The pack is compact and physically separate from the body, not a mountain of cargo. Tiny agency metal identification tag on the chest carrying strap, tiny muted teal soul-stone coupling on one side of the back frame, no other glow.
Frames left to right: 1 grounded low neutral ready stance holding the cart hook; 2 slight inhale raising shoulders and harness a few pixels; 3 exhale and tiny forward weight shift, cloth and rope responding minimally; 4 settle close to frame 1 for a loop. Keep the feet planted and the exact identity/equipment consistent; do not make four identical pasted frames.
Style/medium: match the supplied existing sprites closely: finely textured handcrafted 16-bit inspired pixel-art, visible precise pixel clusters, dark thin contours, selective hard-edged highlights, richly readable but restrained woven cloth/wood/leather shading, realistic stylized adult proportions, muted charcoal, earth brown, worn ochre, dirty linen and tiny desaturated teal. Same small on-sheet visual scale as supplied Defender.
Background: genuine transparent alpha with empty fully transparent space; do not paint any checkerboard, black or white background.
Avoid: shield, armor plates, knight costume, red armor, giant weapons, backpack/body fusion, machinery, steampunk, horns, skulls, monsters, extra limbs, additional characters, scenery, floor, cast shadow, labels, text, grid lines, UI, attack effects, motion trails, blood, photorealism, smooth vector art, 3D render. Only the four character sprites and their equipment.

attack:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: four-frame horizontal pixel-art attack animation sheet, ONE PNG.
Input image: the previous Attacker idle sheet is the exact identity reference. Preserve this same sturdy cloth-hooded porter, face covering across eyes only, revealed nose/mouth, outfit, proportions, colors, backpack frame, rope, mallet, bottle, bandage satchel, metal chest tag and tiny teal frame coupling. Change only poses into an attack.
Primary request: exactly four full-body frames, left to right, for the Attacker's basic skill "진로 개척" / Clear the Way. With both hands gripping the SAME normal-size wooden cart-hook tool, the worker braces, draws it back then shoves its curved iron end forward to push a single unseen target away. It is a short powerful forward shove, NOT an overhead slash or a spear-stab. Hook is a blunt curved cargo/cart hook, not a bladed weapon.
Frame 1: low ready stance matching idle, hook held low across waist.
Frame 2: anticipation, knees bend more, weight on back foot, draw cart-hook handle toward hip and turn torso slightly back; hook points right.
Frame 3: decisive forward thrust-shove, torso leans right, front leg bends and rear leg braces, both arms extend the tool toward the right, keep entire hook inside cell. Backpack follows body naturally and stays strapped on.
Frame 4: withdraw hook and settle toward the original ready stance; neither a duplicate impact frame nor a second attack.
Composition: a single 3:1 horizontal sheet, exactly four equal cells, EXACT 1536x512 pixels preferred, cells 384x512. Each figure centered within its cell, head/body same anatomical size across frames, right-facing three-quarter combat view, boots aligned on one baseline near bottom. Body around 335 pixels tall, weapon and backpack always fully in cell with a generous 16 pixel left/right margin, especially frame 3. No overlapping cell boundaries, cropping, rescaling individual poses or labels.
Style: precisely match original reference idle sheet's finely textured handcrafted pixel-art shading, muted dark brown/charcoal/khaki colors, warm worn wood and leather, dark thin contour, tiny desaturated teal details. Retain same identity and adult androgynous human appearance.
Background: deliver REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA PNG, the background must contain no pixel color or checkerboard pattern. Only characters and carried equipment. No floor and no shadows.
Avoid: target/enemy, impact flashes, motion trails, VFX, dust, ground, UI, grid, writing, checkerboard, extra weapons, shield, armor, knight, giant hook, body fusion, extra limbs, changing hand count, changing clothing. This is the character motion layer only.
